title: Household Air Pollution & COPD
subtitle: Forecasting Burden. Optimising Intervention. Planning for 2040.

kpis.label: Countries Analysed
kpis.detail: India, Nepal, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan (GBD South Asia panel)

kpis.label: Historical Study Period
kpis.detail: 34 annual years (GBD 2023); WHO clean cooking extends to 2024

kpis.label: Forecast Horizon
kpis.detail: 2024–2040 projections; decision periods P1 (2026–30), P2 (2031–35), P3 (2036–40)

kpis.label: Geographical Allocation Units
kpis.detail: IND_urban, IND_rural, NPL_urban, NPL_rural (48 decision vars)

kpis.label: Intervention Categories
kpis.detail: LPG subsidy, Improved biomass, Electric induction, LPG/grid infra

kpis.label: Decision & Planning Methods
kpis.detail: NSGA-II (pymoo), Custom NumPy MDP, HTN Tree, STRIPS/PDDL (pyperplan)

objectives.title: Historical Epidemiology (Stage 1)
objectives.summary: Quantify 1990–2023 HAP-attributable COPD deaths, DALYs, age-standardized rates, EAPC, and joinpoint inflection years across 5 South Asian countries, highlighting India and Nepal.
objectives.status: Pending GBD 2023 export; real WHO/DHS clean-cooking series ready

objectives.title: Burden Forecasting to 2040 (Stage 2)
objectives.summary: Benchmark statistical baselines (ARIMA, ETS, adapted Poisson rate GLM) against panel ML models (Random Forest, HistGradientBoosting) via expanding-window rolling-origin CV and calibrate a fast exposure–response surrogate.
objectives.status: Methodology locked; awaiting Stage 2 implementation & exports

objectives.title: Multi-Objective Resource Allocation (Stage 3)
objectives.summary: Use NSGA-II to minimise projected 2040 DALYs, total intervention cost ($M), and population-weighted female–male ASR burden gap across 4 units × 4 interventions × 3 periods under budget, cap, ceiling, and q < p infra constraints.

objectives.title: Sequential & Symbolic Planning (Stage 4)
objectives.summary: Compare an adaptive stochastic NumPy MDP policy, a hierarchical task network (HTN), and a STRIPS/PDDL classical planner against open-loop NSGA-II schedules on equal-footing stochastic rollouts.

research_questions.question: How have HAP-attributable COPD deaths and DALYs changed in India, Nepal, and wider South Asia from 1990 to 2023, by sex and age-standardised metrics?
research_questions.note: Repository methodology compromise uses aggregated all-age burden and age-standardized rates rather than five-year age-specific burden trajectories.

research_questions.question: Which forecasting approach (statistical or ML) projects attributable burden to 2040 most reliably on held-out rolling-origin validation data?
research_questions.note: Evaluates ARIMA, ETS, adapted Poisson rate GLM, Random Forest, and HistGradientBoosting on MAE, RMSE, and MASE.

research_questions.question: Under a fixed budget, which intervention allocation minimises projected 2040 burden, and how does it trade off against cost and sex-based equity?
research_questions.note: Sex-specific burden response uses a proxy elasticity multiplier due to lack of sex-disaggregated intervention uptake data.

research_questions.question: How does an adaptive planning policy (MDP) compare with a one-off optimised allocation (GA) and symbolic plans (HTN / PDDL)?
research_questions.note: Tested across 1,000 Common-Random-Numbers uptake shock rollouts ([0.5x, 1.0x, 1.25x] with probs [0.15, 0.70, 0.15]).
